recipes.name: Sweet Potato & Zucchini Soup
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over high heat. When hot, add the onion, leek, and garlic. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the remaining ingredients. Cook at a simmer partially covered for 15 minutes, or until the potatoes are cooked.
Using an immersion blender, blend some of the soup but allow some chunks to remain. Alternatively, use a standing blender, in which case blending about half of the soup is recommended.
Taste test, adding more seasoning as desired. Plate, garnish, and serve while hot. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days, or in the freezer for up to 2 months.
